mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 4-week average precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened discount rates eroding expected future cash flows.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, no significant negative returns coincide with FEDFUNDS above 4-week average in non-recessionary regimes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) while UNRATE falls suggests labor market strengthening, which precedes a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investor confidence improves.
failure_condition: In 2008-05 context, no positive 60-day returns when PAYEMS up and UNRATE down during a contractionary regime (e.g., recession).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST (retail sales) above the 12-month moving average predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals resilient consumer demand.
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day returns when HOUST crosses above 12-month avg during deflationary or supply shock periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production) below the 6-month moving average triggers a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as weak manufacturing signals contraction risks.
failure_condition: No negative 5-day returns when INDPRO falls below 6-month avg during non-recessionary supply cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in CPIAUCSL (CPI) over three consecutive months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as inflation expectations fall and equity discount rates rise.
failure_condition: No negative 20-day returns when CPIAUCSL declines for 3 months in non-stagflationary environments.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months in a non-recessionary context, it predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower borrowing costs boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: No positive 60-day returns when UNRATE drops below 4% during contractionary periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their respective 3-month averages predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as dual demand signals boost optimism.
failure_condition: No positive 20-day returns when both proxies are above 3-month avg during supply-side shocks.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in GDPC1 (GDP) below the 12-month average combined with a rise in FEDFUNDS triggers a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as contractionary policy offsets weak demand.
failure_condition: No negative 5-day returns when GDP falls and FEDFUNDS rises during non-recessionary periods.
